# [BOOM-5963] Shopping cart is created automatically after login

When a customer sign in, an empty cart of 0€ is created.

## Attendu
The cart should be created only when the customer adds a product.

## Étapes
1. BO > SELL > Orders > Shopping Carts > check the list
2. FO > login as client
3. BO > refresh the Shopping Carts list > a new cart with the client name is created
